rationale: Both vaults enforce test-data discipline: final evaluation must use data untouched during training and tuning. The course file 01 defines the protocol explicitly (three-way split; the test set is 'a completely locked dataset used only once at the very end to evaluate the final performance'); master-ai states the discipline as a best practice ('Always evaluate on held-out data') and, in its pitfalls list, names the failure modes ('Test set leakage — feature engineering on the whole dataset, time-based splits ignored'). Shared claim: never let training/tuning touch the final-evaluation data. Non-shared: the course's explicit 70/15/15 percentages and the validation-set role; master-ai's leakage taxonomy (whole-dataset feature engineering, ignored time-based splits). Partial overlap.
